notes.note: Scoped review of the new Shared export against the documented boundary conventions: mcp-app-result is a browser-safe, side-effect-free presentation reader imported by the UI and EventStore through its explicit subpath. It grants no URI read or session action authority. Existing exports and dependencies are unchanged; route validation, remote-query ownership, and runtime/service separation claims need no prose change.
